tags.chapter_name: General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Metals

question.text: Extraction for zinc from zinc blende is achieved by

options.text: roasting followed by reduction with carbon
roasting followed by reduction with another metal

solution.text:
Zinc blende is roasted and then treated with coke for the reduction.
$$
\begin{gathered}
2 \mathrm{ZnS}+3 \mathrm{O}_2 \stackrel{\Delta}{\longrightarrow} 2 \mathrm{ZnO}+2 \mathrm{SO}_2 \uparrow \\
\mathrm{ZnO}+\mathrm{C} \stackrel{\Delta}{\longrightarrow} \mathrm{Zn}+\mathrm{CO} \uparrow
\end{gathered}
$$
